summary: An enhanced choice question. Rows are choices; the DQ restyles them and records interaction. The reference implementation every other archetype copies its structure from.
use_when: the request is about how choices LOOK or how selection BEHAVES
there is no media, no timing and no external SDK
you need a worked example of the package conventions

questions.ask: Which question types must this attach to? radio, checkbox, or both?
questions.why: meta.xml <scope> must be the narrowest true scope, and the demo has to prove every scope it claims. A DQ claiming radio,checkbox with a radio-only demo is untested for half its surface.

questions.ask: Does the respondent's answer come from the normal question, or does the DQ record something extra?
questions.why: The normal answer is already a survey variable. Anything extra needs a capture block in the adopting survey, because a DQ cannot declare survey variables.
affects: whether a capture block is needed at all

questions.ask: What must be recorded beyond the answer, and per what? Per row, or once per question?
questions.why: Row count and shape are the capture contract. Getting it wrong is unrecoverable once fieldwork starts.

questions.ask: Which visual settings does a Survey Designer choose per survey, and which are fixed by us?
questions.why: Every parameter is public API. An unclassified one ends up restated on every adopting question, pinning those surveys to today's behaviour.

questions.ask: Desktop only, or mobile too? If mobile, is touch interaction required?
questions.why: Touch and viewport behaviour cannot be validated by emulation and need a real-device handoff.

parameters.name: accent
parameters.desc: Colour of the selected card border and its check mark.

parameters.name: density
parameters.desc: comfortable gives each card more padding; compact fits more on a phone screen without scrolling.

parameters.name: capture_order
parameters.desc: Name of the survey variable that records the order rows were touched. Do not change; it must match the pasted capture block.

capture.label: __DQ_UPPER___ORDER
capture.desc: For each row, the 1-based order in which it was first touched. Empty means never touched.
capture.note: sized for up to 10 question rows; meta.xml count is bounded to match
